questions.prompt: There are enough apples and bananas at home. You _______ buy any fruit.
questions.topicReason: 考查情态动词need的否定形式；根据前句水果足够可知“不必买”，用needn't。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海金山初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: You ________ walk on the grass in the park. It’s against the rules.
questions.topicReason: 考查情态动词mustn’t表示禁止；根据against the rules可知是“不准”。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海闵行初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: We’ve already booked the train tickets. You ________ worry about getting seats any more.
questions.topicReason: 考查情态动词needn’t表示“不必”；根据已订票可知不用再担心座位。
